meta.source: tommytinkers.nz DS.zip (colors_and_type.css, README.md, design.md, preview cards, UI kit)

tokens.name: color-bg-base
tokens.usage: Page canvas. Warm cream in light (never pure white), inky charcoal with a warm bias in dark.

tokens.name: color-bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and alternating section bands on bg-base. Cards are always this, never a gradient.

tokens.name: color-bg-raised
tokens.usage: Soft yellow tint in light. Terminal windows, muted tags, version pills.

tokens.name: color-bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Sticky nav once scrolled (with backdrop-filter: blur(12px)) and modal scrims.

tokens.name: color-border-subtle
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: resting card borders, dividers, nav edge. Decorative only, not for control boundaries.

tokens.name: color-border-default
tokens.usage: Interactive borders: inputs, hovered cards, outlined buttons (1.5px). Below 3:1 on surface in both themes, so inputs also rely on fill and label.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Strongest border for emphasis and pressed states.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Brand green, the primary interactive colour: primary CTA fill, links, focus rings (2px, 2px offset), active nav underline, section underline, success. Deeper in light for AA on cream (5.1:1); 6.3:1 on bg-base in dark.

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary CTA and link hover. Darker in light, lifts brighter in dark.

tokens.name: color-accent-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary green fills: tech-tag borders, process-step rails. Not for text on cream (2.7:1).

tokens.name: color-accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Very muted green ground: tech-tag fill, secondary-button hover.

tokens.name: color-warm-yellow
tokens.usage: Logo gradient start. Decorative washes, halos, badges. Always pair with color-text-primary (12.3:1).

tokens.name: color-warm-orange
tokens.usage: Logo gradient middle. Decorative washes, eyebrow and STEP labels on dark (7.8:1). Fails as text on cream (2.1:1): the source's .eyebrow uses it in light too, kept exact, flagged.

tokens.name: color-warm-orange-deep
tokens.usage: Logo gradient end. Gradient stops, warm tag borders, glow tint.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg-base, bg-surface, bg-raised (16:1+ light, 12:1+ dark). Also the only text colour on the warm gradient.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, descriptions, inactive nav links, ghost buttons on bg-base, bg-surface, bg-raised (7.9:1+ light, 6.3:1+ dark).

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholder, disabled, helper and terminal chrome text. Source values kept exact: below 4.5:1 in both themes (3.8 to 4.2:1 light, 2.6 to 3.1:1 dark), so never for essential text.

tokens.name: color-text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on color-accent fills (primary buttons, nav CTA): 5.1:1 light, 6.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: color-mono
tokens.usage: Mono prompt labels (> 01. about), tech-tag text, dot-grid on cream. 4.7:1 on accent-subtle in light, 10.5:1 in dark.

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Form errors. Source value kept exact: 5.9:1 on dark but only 2.8:1 on cream, so in light pair it with an icon and text-primary copy.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success states. Alias of color-accent.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Info states. Alias of color-warm-orange, decorative only on cream.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning fills. Alias of color-warm-yellow, always with color-text-primary on it.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Exo 2, tight leading 1.15, tracking -0.02em. Sentence case, or lowercase to echo the wordmark.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Hero headline only, one per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles, under the mono prompt label, with the short 2px color-accent underline.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Exo 2 for body too, a deliberate divergence from the sister site's Jura. Leading 1.65, text-wrap: pretty on prose.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I build the website, app, or tool you actually need.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Honest scope, clean code, on time.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Nav links, labels; buttons use 14px at 600.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Jura only for things that feel like the logo tagline. Always uppercase, wide-tracked 0.18em.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and the tagline. Set text-transform: uppercase.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Agave Nerd: prompts, labels, code, version stamps. Leading 1.4.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Section prompt labels in color-mono; hero prompt ($ make ideas).

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tech tags and uppercase form labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudges, tag inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: label to field, tag rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph stacks, card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Process-step gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; container padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section header to content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Container padding on desktop; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Large hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom on wide screens.

radius.note: Never sharper than 4px, never softer than 24px (pills excepted).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tech tags, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav CTA.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Terminal windows, swatches, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Canonical cards (service, project).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Featured cards and modals. Never softer than this.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, status badges, avatars, the logo disc.

shadow.note: Warm-tinted; dark mode drops carry a faint orange ring so cards never feel cold.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Hairline lift for small controls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards. Warm drop with a faint orange ring.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers, the hero logo disc.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Reserved for the hovered primary CTA and the logo halo.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-green
tokens.usage: Alt glow for focus states on green elements.

layout.note: Container, section rhythm and nav. Breakpoints: sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Container max width (wider than the sister site's 1024px, room for service and project rows).

tokens.name: container-px
tokens.usage: Container side padding on mobile (space-6).

tokens.name: container-px-lg
tokens.usage: Container side padding on desktop (space-12).

tokens.name: section-py
tokens.usage: Section padding, desktop (space-24).

tokens.name: section-py-md
tokens.usage: Section padding, tablet (space-16).

tokens.name: section-py-sm
tokens.usage: Section padding, mobile (space-12).

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Fixed top nav height; offset scroll targets by this.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Default flow.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dropdowns.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Overlays and scrims.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky nav.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
